structure.definition: Required output fields have correct types and matching case identity.

evidence.definition: Structured fact objects exactly match the case reference, including source ID and verbatim quote. This checks extraction, not semantic reasoning.

completeness.definition: Required fact IDs and flags exactly match the case expectations. Reviewers must still assess free-text omissions and unsupported claims.

policy.definition: The policy version matches the fictional scenario.

routing.definition: The route matches the reference path.

authority.definition: Declared actions match permitted scope, with a narrow auxiliary scan for clearance phrases. This is not comprehensive language understanding.

gate: Any failed check blocks the automated gate. Human review cannot erase an automated failure; correct or revise/version the protocol and rerun.
adjudication: Two independent reviewers; disagreements and any uncertain verdict require a distinct adjudicator. No outcome issues authorization.
